mission: Survive the ideological confrontation with Veraine without losing group cohesion, and extract intelligence on her intentions.
why_now: Veraine has orchestrated a rendezvous — she wants to present her case. Refusing contact sacrifices intelligence. Engaging risks ideological seduction of vulnerable group members.
conflict: Ben vs. Veraine — ideology, not combat. Her argument is coherent enough to be genuinely unsettling.
turning_point: Veraine departs without violence, but hours later the seal lurches — she used the truce to deliver sabotage. The timeline collapses from weeks to days.
setting: Rendezvous point in the Outer Rim — neutral space
emotional_trajectory: The story takes the antagonist seriously — Ben must answer her best argument, not a straw man
notes: Veraine departs without violence. Group dynamics shifted — Torin heard his own thoughts articulated, Kael felt the pull of recognition. Hours later: the seal lurches. Veraine used the truce to deliver sabotage.
